page.overview:
Who is Sugar Grape?

Sugar Grape is a female Pegasus pony who appears in the IDW comics. She has a white coat, two-tone purple mane and tail, dark blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a bunch of grapes. She first appeared in merchandise.__TOC__

Sugar Grape shares her design with Rainbow Dash, Daring Do, Skywishes, Lucky Dreams, Sweetsong, Breezie, Feathermay, Periwinkle, Star Dasher, and sometimes Ploomette and Banana Bliss, she shares her mane and tail style with Holly Dash, "Doseydotes", "Ballad", Léon, and Roku-chan, she shares her mane style with Andrea, she shares her tail style with "Sunstone" and WCE Unnamed Mare - Jouster, and she resembles "Downdraft".

According to Andy Price, "random blind bags" are how Sugar Grape, Cherry Spices, and Sweetcream Scoops "got into the comic".

On page 11, Sugar Grape appears, with a thought bubble, watching Applejack and Rarity fly by in an aircraft.
